notes.title: Patch Indev 3.5.3
notes.content:
Hello guys, it's been quiete sometimes since the last update that i delivered.
I'm really appologize for the late update delivery since i'm still have a trouble to finacing this game, but it won't stop me to give a new update and content to you.

without further delay, i present to you update indev patch 3.5.3

What's new?

- Adding new item: Simple Bullets, Gun Powder, and Simple Rifle can now be crafted in the crafting table

Bug fix:

- Fixing bug of using axe or pick accidentally when opening inventory

more content will be added of course, and i hope i can deliver it faster to you

regards,

Chicken Sale
Developer

notes.title: Patch 3.5.2
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome back, finally after a long 3 week full of struggle and difficulties we managed to back in track, with out further delay we announce to you the update Indev Patch 3.5.2

what's new:

Adding a new carnivore into the map, the Giganoto Carno will now roam the island as one of the animal the survivor must conquer to stay alive. This animal can be found across all area of the map


now there some bad new and good news come with this update:

Good news:
I manage to find time to reschedule and continue the development of this game, i also got a small funding to further develope the game so it can get closer to the end quality

Bad news:

I need to take another job to get some money so i can continue to develope and funding this game and that job is taking quiete time, as a result there will be a little delay of the update but i will keep it as regular as posible and continue working the game in between my job time and will not abandone this game

i am really sorry for this, thank you very much for your support

Best regards,

ChickenSale

Developer

notes.title: Patch 3.5.1
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome, patch indev 3.5.1 is out now and ready for you

what's new?

- Fixing bug on the cutting tree system, before tree will be randomly moving when cut

- Some minor change on the Terrain to improve stability

notes.title: Patch 3.5.0
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome back, patch Indev 3.5.0 is out now

What's new?

- Adding some changes on the terrain
- Character Controller overhaul to fix bug and adding underwater control

Bug fix:

- Fixing bug on the building system

notes.title: Patch 3.4.9
notes.content:
Hello guys and thank you for your support, a new patch is ready for you, patch indev 3.4.9 is live now

Whats new?

- Adding new building structures: Trapdoor Frame, Window Frame, and Ladder.
- Building system upgrade to allow you to make a vertical base, you can create a 2nd, 3rd, or more floor to your base.

Changes:

- Right click button on the mouse now disable all active building model when placing building structure.

Bug fix:

- Fixing position bug when placing a door on the door frame
- Fixing position bug when creating L shape wall

notes.title: Patch 3.4.8
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome, i'm really happy to inform you that patch indev 3.4.8 is out now

what's new?

In this patch we add an aquatic biome for the game with 2 new aquatic animal inside.

there are 2 animal that is added:

-Testudo Cetus
- Sea Grabbers

these animal can be found in every corner of the sea and will give you some more challange inside the game

notes.title: Patch 3.4.7
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome, finally after a long 2 weeks the new patch Indev 3.4.7 is ready for you.

Whats new?

- Adding 2 new crew member npc
- Adding 3 new story quest
- Adding some underwater foliage

Bug fix:

- Fixing bug in the quest window, now all quest will be shows up on the quest window.
- Fixing bug on the stone and crystal, now stone and crystal will no longer suddenly dissapear when player close to it

notes.title: Patch 3.4.6
notes.content:
Hello guys and thank you for your support, i'm happy to announce that Patch Indev 3.4.6 is out now

What's new?

- Adding new animal: Spitting Spider
- Adding new item: Arrow can be crafted now
- Adding new Oxygen System

Changes:

- Shooting bow is now limited by the number of arrow you crafted inside you inventory
- Diving time will be limited by oxygen level that you have, once the oxyge level drop to 0 your health will start to decrease

notes.title: Patch 3.4.5
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome, finally after a long week the new patch is here, update Indev 3.4.5 is out and ready for you

whats new?
- Adding new items: Battery, Electronic Part, and Radio tranceiver
- Adding first NPC: Claire can be found on Lat 63, Lon 65
- Adding first Story quest, quest can bee access in NPC Claire
- Adding new UI: Quest Window  can be open by pressing O

Changes: 
- Alpha Animal now drop electronic part instead of meat
- Changing some area in map
- Arrow cannot be spam shoot anymore, arrow can only shoot if you pull the string 100%

Bug fix: 
- Guide for cooking will not dissapear again

notes.title: Patch 3.4.4 is out now
notes.content:
Hello guys and wellcome, the patch Indev 3.4.4 is out now with some new content and feature

what's new?

- Adding blood mark that will show up when Hp under 50%
- Adding under water layer so you will find different atmosphere when going under the water
- Adding map to make you more eassy when navigate the play area and finding location
- Adding item: Liquid core and Medicine, you can craft medicine in the crafting table now

Changes:

- Wisp no longer give meat when salvage but a liquid core
- Remaking game post processing to give better performance

Bug fix:

- Player no longer spawn on the last log in spawn point but instead spawn on the last saved location when respawn from dead

notes.title: Patch 3.4.3
notes.content:
Hello guys, i hope you all good and healthy, once again i want to say thank you for all the people who supporting this game up until now. As my appreciation to you, i happily delivered the patch 3.4.3 update

what's new?

- Adding new animal: Wisp, this ellusive insect can be found all over the island
- Adding hit mark, now when your arrow hit animal a red crosshair will show up
- Adding ingame guide, you can access it by pressing G
- Adding Save and continue button, you can save your game without exiting it now and continue to play
- Berries now can give player a small amount of water in addition of small amount of food

Bug fix:

- Fixing cursor that sometimes not show up when open inventory
- Fixing multiple model spawn when placing structure, now only 1 type of model spawn at a time when you place structure 
- Fixing unable to save game after creating a furnace and stove, you can save your game safely now

notes.title: Patch 3.4.2
notes.content:
Wellcome and thank you very much for everyone who support us and bought this game. This game may not be completed yet but we are working hard to improve the quality of the game and now we presented to you the patch 3.4.2

what's new?

improvements:

- Adding 2 alpha animal into the game 
- Adding reset button to reset the game
- Adding ingame Announce box so player can easily track the update

bug fixes:

- Animal AI overhoul to improve the response of animal towards player and giving more optimal performance
